findings.issue: Syncing URL props into local state with useEffect means a landing RSC response resets the input, so text typed during the server round-trip is momentarily reverted (lost-keystroke race).
findings.suggestion: Track the last-applied value and only sync when the prop differs from it, or make the input uncontrolled and read the query via useSearchParams.

findings.issue: Any non-404 API error throws inside server components and there is no error.js anywhere, surfacing an unstyled 500 instead of a recoverable state.
findings.suggestion: Add an app/error.js (and per-route if needed) with a retry action.

findings.issue: A malformed index response silently becomes an empty list, so the home page shows `No Pokémon found` instead of an error.
findings.suggestion: Treat a missing/empty result set as a failure (throw) rather than an empty collection.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled global promise cache; Next 16.4 recommends Cache Components (`use cache` + `cacheLife`) which makes caching declarative and enables instant navigations, and it becomes the default in 17.
findings.suggestion: Note the migration path in a comment, or adopt `use cache` on the derived loaders so the codebase is ready for Next 17.

findings.issue: `prefetch={false}` is applied uniformly to every link, disabling prefetch/instant navigation with no comment explaining why.
findings.suggestion: Keep it only where it's justified (48-card dynamic grids) and add a comment, or drop it if Cache Components is adopted.

findings.issue: `typeLabel` is duplicated in types/[name] and pokemon/[name] pages, and `MISSING` is re-declared in MovesTable.js instead of importing lib/format.
findings.suggestion: Move `typeLabel` into lib/format (or a small lib/types helper) and import MISSING everywhere.

findings.issue: Row key includes the array index (`${row.moveHref}:${row.level}:${index}`).
findings.suggestion: Use a stable composite key such as move name + level + method.

findings.issue: The repo's .gitignore has no entry for `.next` and app/ has no .gitignore of its own, so the committed-looking build output in app/.next risks being checked in.
findings.suggestion: Add an app/.gitignore (or a root `.next/` rule) covering build output.

findings.issue: buildMovesSection mixes grouping, version-group ordering and row shaping in one ~75-line function, and no route has loading.js, so dynamic navigations show the previous page until the server responds.
findings.suggestion: Split into groupByGame/orderMethods/buildRows helpers and consider a simple loading.tsx for the heavy Pokémon page.

summary: A clean, current-idiom App Router implementation: async params, RSC data loading, proper 404s, tiny client islands, and a well-factored data layer with a thoughtful derived-types cache. The main merge blockers are minor: a URL-sync race in the search input, no error boundary for API failures, and small helper duplication; the hand-rolled cache and blanket prefetch={false} will need revisiting when Next 17 makes Cache Components the default. I'd approve after one round of small changes.
